category_edits.rationale: Test residual scaling of 0.8 across all four category models. The previously evaluated 0.5 scaling regressed; milder damping may preserve useful convolution updates while limiting accumulated noise. Keep all other settings unchanged. The generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training/inference consistency and one checkpoint per category.

response.change_summary: Apply fixed 0.8 residual scaling to every NextItNet causal convolution block, a configuration distinct from the evaluated 0.5 scaling.
